q: Three 6 Ω resistors in parallel are connected in series with a 4 Ω resistor. The total resistance is:
The hot resistance of a 100 W, 220 V lamp is:
A 24 V source with a 6 Ω series resistor has 3 Ω across the output terminals. The Thevenin equivalent is:
why: Vth = 24 × 3/9 = 8 V (voltage divider); Rth = 6 ∥ 3 = 2 Ω.

q: For that source, the maximum power any load can draw is:
why: P_max = Vth²/(4Rth) = 64/8 = 8 W, at R_L = 2 Ω.

q: For v = 100 sin(100πt) V, the frequency and RMS value are:
A series circuit has R = 10 Ω, X_L = 20 Ω, X_C = 10 Ω. Its power factor is:
why: Z = √(10² + 10²) = 14.14 Ω; PF = R/Z = 0.707; X_L > X_C, so the circuit is inductive and current lags.

q: An ideal bridge rectifier is fed with 12 V RMS. The average (DC) output voltage is about:
why: Vm = 12√2 = 16.97 V; full-wave Vdc = 2Vm/π ≈ 10.8 V.

q: A transistor has β = 100. Its α is about:
An RC phase-shift oscillator with three identical RC sections needs a minimum amplifier gain of:
why: Each section gives 60°, total 180°; the feedback network attenuates by 1/29, so |A| ≥ 29 (Barkhausen).

q: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has R_f = 90 kΩ and R₁ = 10 kΩ. Its voltage gain is:
The 8-bit two's-complement representation of −88 is:
AB + AB' simplifies to:
why: AB + AB' = A(B + B') = A · 1 = A.

q: The minimum number of 2-input NAND gates needed to build an XOR gate is:
why: The standard NAND-only XOR uses four gates.

q: A BCD adder adds 0110 to the binary sum when:
opts: the sum is greater than 9 or there is a carry out
why: Sums above 9 (or with a carry) are invalid BCD; adding 6 skips the six unused codes.

q: The minimum number of flip-flops for a mod-12 counter is:
A 4-bit Johnson (twisted-ring) counter has how many distinct states?
why: A Johnson counter with n flip-flops has 2n states.

q: The 8085 instruction MVI B, 05H uses which addressing mode?
why: The operand 05H is part of the instruction.

q: The 8085 instruction XCHG exchanges:
why: XCHG swaps the HL and DE register pairs.

q: A 2764 EPROM is organised as 8K × 8. It needs how many address lines?
why: 8K = 2¹³ locations.

q: In the 8086, the interrupt vector for type 8 is stored at physical address:
why: Type n is at 4n: 4 × 8 = 32 = 20H.

q: printf("%d", 'a' - 'A'); prints:
why: ASCII 'a' = 97, 'A' = 65; difference 32.

q: for (i = 1; i <= 10; i += 3) count++; — count increases how many times?
why: i takes 1, 4, 7, 10 → four iterations (then i = 13).

q: For int a[10];, the expression sizeof(a) / sizeof(a[0]) gives:
why: Total bytes divided by bytes per element = number of elements.

q: char *p = "NEC"; printf("%c", *(p + 1)); prints:
why: p + 1 points to the second character.

q: Which of these is not a member function of the class it accesses?
why: A friend is declared inside the class but is not a member.

q: A constructor that takes no arguments is called a:
why: The default constructor has no parameters (or all defaulted).

q: A pure virtual function is declared as:
why: "= 0" after a virtual function declaration makes it pure; the class becomes abstract.

q: Function overriding requires the derived-class function to have:
opts: the same signature as the base function
why: Same name and parameter list; with virtual it dispatches at run time.

q: The keyword that begins a generic function or class definition in C++ is:
why: template <typename T> …

q: Which C++ statement handles any exception type?
why: The ellipsis handler catches everything and must come last.

q: Which is a characteristic of RISC processors?
why: RISC accesses memory only through load and store instructions.

q: In microprogrammed control, the microprogram is stored in:
why: A control memory (ROM) holds the microinstructions.

q: A 16 KB direct-mapped cache with 64-byte blocks and 32-bit byte addresses has a tag of:
why: 256 lines → index 8 bits; offset 6 bits; tag = 32 − 8 − 6 = 18.

q: The exponent bias in IEEE 754 single precision is:
why: 8-bit exponent, bias 2⁷ − 1 = 127 (double: 1023).

q: A DMA controller that takes the bus for one word at a time between CPU cycles is using:
why: Cycle stealing interleaves single transfers with CPU bus use.

q: In daisy-chain interrupt priority, priority is decided by:
opts: the device's position in the chain
why: The acknowledge signal passes along the chain; the nearest requesting device takes it.

q: In embedded-system design metrics, NRE cost is:
opts: the one-time cost of designing the system
why: Non-recurring engineering cost is paid once, however many units are made.

q: Rate-monotonic scheduling assigns higher priority to tasks with:
why: Static priority by period: shorter period, higher priority.

q: A low-priority task holds a resource needed by a high-priority task while a medium task runs. This is:
why: Fixed by priority inheritance or priority ceiling.

q: In VHDL, a signal is assigned with:
why: Signals use <=; variables use :=.

q: Routing between networks is a function of which OSI layer?
why: The network layer forwards packets using logical (IP) addresses.

q: How many Hamming check bits are needed for 8 data bits?
The maximum throughput of pure ALOHA is about:
why: S = G e^(−2G), maximum 1/(2e) at G = 0.5.

q: Host 192.168.1.130/26 is in network:
The broadcast address of that network is:
why: Next network starts at 192, so broadcast = 191.

q: An IPv6 address is:
why: IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses.

q: The minimum TCP header size is:
why: 20 bytes without options (UDP: 8).

q: DNS queries normally use:
why: DNS uses UDP 53 (TCP 53 for large responses and zone transfers).

q: Which tool graphs interface traffic over time by polling devices with SNMP?
why: MRTG = Multi Router Traffic Grapher.

q: A Caesar cipher with shift 3 encrypts "NEC" as:
why: N→Q, E→H, C→F.

q: The minimum DFA accepting binary strings that end in "01" has how many states?
why: States track: nothing useful, last bit 0, last two bits 01.

q: The pumping lemma for regular languages is used to:
opts: convert an NFA to a DFA
prove a language is not regular
why: It gives a property every regular language has; failing it proves non-regularity.

q: In Chomsky normal form, every production is of the form:
why: GNF is A → aα (terminal followed by variables).

q: A pushdown automaton is a finite automaton plus:
why: PDAs accept exactly the context-free languages.

q: Which problem is undecidable?
why: No TM decides whether an arbitrary TM halts on an arbitrary input.

q: Context-sensitive (type 1) languages are accepted by:
why: Type 0 → TM, 1 → LBA, 2 → PDA, 3 → FA.

q: An 800 × 600 raster display with 8 bits per pixel needs a frame buffer of:
Rotating the point (1, 0) by 90° anticlockwise about the origin gives:
why: x' = x cos θ − y sin θ = 0; y' = x sin θ + y cos θ = 1.

q: A Cohen–Sutherland region code has:
why: Top, bottom, right, left.

q: In perspective projection, parallel lines not parallel to the projection plane:
why: Projectors meet at the centre of projection, so distant objects shrink and parallels converge.

q: The value of the postfix expression 2 3 4 * + is:
The maximum number of nodes in a binary tree of height 4 (root at height 0) is:
The maximum number of comparisons for binary search on 1024 sorted elements is:
Which sorting algorithm has O(n log n) worst-case time and sorts in place?
why: Heap sort: O(n log n) always, O(1) extra space.

q: A relation in 2NF with no transitive dependency of non-prime attributes on a key is in:
why: That is the definition of 3NF.

q: The ACID property that keeps committed changes after a crash is:
why: Durability is provided by the recovery system (log on stable storage).

q: Processes with bursts 5, 3 and 8 all arrive at time 0. Under SJF, the average waiting time is:
The semaphore operation that may block the calling process is:
why: wait (P) blocks when the value is not positive.

q: Page size 4 KB. Logical address 20000 lies on page:
Reference string 1 2 3 4 1 2 with 3 frames under FIFO gives how many page faults?
why: 1, 2, 3 fault; 4 replaces 1; 1 replaces 2; 2 replaces 3 — every reference faults.

q: The process model organised around repeated risk analysis is:
why: Boehm's spiral: planning, risk analysis, engineering, evaluation in each loop.

q: "The system shall support 500 concurrent users" is a:
why: It constrains performance, not behaviour.

q: The most desirable type of cohesion is:
why: All elements contribute to one well-defined task.

q: A control-flow graph has 9 edges and 7 nodes. Its cyclomatic complexity is:
Testing done by users at the customer's site, without developers present, is:
why: Alpha is at the developer's site; beta is at the customer's.

q: Which CMMI level introduces organisation-wide standard processes?
why: Defined: standard processes tailored per project.

q: A conceptual (domain) model shows:
opts: conceptual classes, associations and attributes — no methods
why: Methods are added later in the design class diagram.

q: The GRASP pattern that gives a responsibility to the class holding the needed information is:
why: Information Expert.

q: Visibility from object A to B because B is passed as a method argument is:
why: The four kinds are attribute, parameter, local and global.

q: A one-to-many association in a design is usually implemented as:
why: The "many" end becomes a collection.

q: PEAS stands for:
why: The task-environment description for designing an agent.

q: An environment whose next state is completely determined by the current state and the agent's action is:
why: Deterministic vs stochastic.

q: A* search evaluates nodes with:
why: Path cost so far plus estimated cost to the goal; optimal with an admissible h.

q: Alpha–beta pruning improves:
why: It skips branches that cannot change the minimax decision.

q: Resolution refutation succeeds when it derives:
why: Adding the negated goal and reaching the empty clause proves the goal.

q: Forward chaining in an expert system is:
why: It starts from known facts and fires rules towards conclusions; backward chaining is goal-driven.

q: k-means clustering is an example of:
why: It groups unlabelled data.

q: Which is a genetic-algorithm operator?
why: GA operators: selection, crossover, mutation.

q: A single-layer perceptron cannot learn:
why: XOR is not linearly separable; an MLP with backpropagation can learn it.

q: The output range of the sigmoid activation function is:
why: tanh gives −1 to 1; ReLU 0 to ∞.

q: The size of an A4 sheet is:
why: A3 is 297 × 420; each size halves the one above.

q: In third-angle projection, the top view is drawn:
opts: to the left of the front view
why: First angle puts it below; third angle above.

q: Rs 10,000 invested at 10% compounded annually for 2 years becomes:
An asset costs Rs 1,00,000 with salvage Rs 10,000 after 5 years. Straight-line depreciation per year is:
PERT estimates: optimistic 2, most likely 5, pessimistic 14 days. The expected time is:
Activities on the critical path have:
why: The critical path is the longest path; delaying any of it delays the project.

q: Which contract is not a cost-plus type?
why: Lump-sum and item-rate contracts are fixed-price types.

q: Buying insurance against a project risk is a risk response called:
why: Transfer shifts the impact to a third party.

q: The statutory body that registers engineers in Nepal is:
why: NEA is the professional association; NEC is the regulator.

q: The Nepal Engineering Council Act was enacted in:
why: Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055.
